title: Science Undergraduate Laboratory Internships (SULI), Summer 2027
institution: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science
field: Science and engineering research at DOE national laboratories
about: DOE Office of Science summer 2027 undergraduate research internships (SULI, alongside the Community College Internships program). The application system opened October 14, 2026; applications close January 6, 2027 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern.
requirements: Hard deadline: no materials accepted after the submission deadline
Recommendation letters must also be in by the deadline

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: Field "Science and engineering research at DOE national laboratories" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

Seniority "Undergraduate" research internship → objective "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

Requirement "Hard deadline: no materials accepted after the submission deadline" → objective "Improve academic workflows involving writing support ... note organization, document analysis" (organizing application materials ahead of time)
